l-e-e5-b03-12.material: I will → I'll, we will → we'll, you will → you'll. Wara règle na bâ kirikiri contraction ti they will.

l-e-e5-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Exemples ota kue asara kete will ga 'll, ndani they will nga ayeke ga they'll.
l-e-e5-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Modèle ayeke tongaso, a zia 'll na pekoni ti sujet, ndani a bâ kirikiri so ni ayeke they'll.

l-e-e5-b04-11.title: Comparatif ti thin ayeke nye?
l-e-e5-b04-11.goal: Wara na tene règle na ndö ti cas mingi ti comparatif so asara double ti lettre ti nda, na pekoni bâ règle na cas ti sika.
l-e-e5-b04-11.material: big → bigger, hot → hotter, sad → sadder. Wara règle ti zia -er na mot ota so na sara na ni na thin.

l-e-e5-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: Ni asara double ti n ti nda pëpe. Ni akpa règle.
l-e-e5-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: Ni agbu règle ti mot so asi na y na erreur.
l-e-e5-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: Mot kete a sara na -er na place ti more.
l-e-e5-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Mot kete so asi na consonne oko asara double ti consonne ti nda na azia -er. thin → thinner.
l-e-e5-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Tongana big, hot, na sad, mo sara double ti consonne ti nda na zia er, ni la thin agä thinner nga.
l-e-e5-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Mot ota kue agbu lettre ti nda ngoi use, ni la comparatif ti thin ayeke thinner.

l-e-e5-b04-13.s.s1.explain: Mbeni phrase na be going to asara question na ti tambela verbe be (am, is, are) na kozo ti sujet.

l-e-e5-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Na acas kue, verbe be asï kozo, ni la mo tene Are we going to swim?

l-e-e5-b02-34.goal: Sara comparaison ti inférence use so a sara na texte, fa oko so alingbi mingi, na fa ndali ti mo.
l-e-e5-b02-34.material: Texte: The street was wet. People carried umbrellas. Inférence A: It is raining or it just rained. B: People love umbrellas.
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.prompt: Inférence wa indice ti texte akpe mingi, na ndali ti nye?
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Rue so ayeke ngû na parapluie akpe ngû
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.o.b: B: Ala akpe parapluie, ni la ala aye ni
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.r.b: Azo alingbi ti kpe parapluie ndali ti so ala aye ni pëpe me ndali ti so ala a hunda ni.
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.o.c: A: Texte ayeke na mot rain, ni la ni ayeke tâ
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.r.c: Texte ayeke na mot rain pëpe. A sara inférence na indice.
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.o.d: B: umbrellas asi, ni la ni ayeke tâ
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.r.d: Mot so asi afa pëpe so azo aye ye.
l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s1.explain: Rue so ayeke ngû na parapluie ayeke indice so ngû asi wala asi sika. Texte atene ye oko pëpe ti aye ni.

l-e-e5-b02-34.s.s2.model.1: B ayeke idée so ndali ayeke na texte pëpe, ni la A, so ayeke na indice, ayeke inférence nzoni mingi.

l-e-e5-b03-31.material: Lac A ayeke 8 m profond na 20 km tî long. Lac B ayeke 5 m profond na 30 km tî long. C: Lac A ayeke kota ahon Lac B. D: Lac A ayeke plus profond ahon Lac B.
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.prompt: Phrase wa alingbi na données nzoni ahon, na ndali wa?
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.o.a: C: A tene Lac A kozo, ndali ni ayeke kota ahon
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.r.a: Tene ni kozo ayeke preuve so ni ayeke kota ahon ape.
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.o.b: D: Profondeur 8 m > 5 m, ndali ni plus profond ayeke correct
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.o.c: C: Ni ayeke plus profond, ndali ni ayeke kota ahon na lege kûê
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.r.c: Lac B ayeke longue ahon, ndali ni mo lingbi tî tene ape so ayeke kota ahon na lege kûê.
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.o.d: D: Longueur 20 km ayeke kota ahon 30 km
l-e-e5-b03-31.s.s1.r.d: 20 ayeke kêtê ahon 30. Lac B ayeke longue ahon.
